name: Seolbaeg
source:
A mysterious man who appeared in Jamie's dreams. He looks surprisingly similar to Shinju's ex, Seonyu. He has a doll-like face and an androgynous appearance, almost as if he stopped growing.

He's a shut-in that's always locked in his library. Secretly he likes to read romance novels despite being scared of other human beings.

[From in-game profile]
